durability_gaps: Execution state not fully journaled before side effects.
Billing telemetry depends on in-memory aggregation between flushes.
No unified event log for agent lifecycle + billing + settlement correlations.
Stuck-reserved transaction handling appears manual/operational rather than automatic deterministic reconciliation.

event_driven_maturity.notes: Event concepts exist (Kafka mention, webhooks, logs) but not a repository-wide durable event contract.

persistence_strategy.assessment: Strong DB presence but weak workflow durability boundaries
